sonnet.problem: The card says Jesus 'sets that judge right next to God.' Verse 6 only says 'Listen to the words of the unjust judge.' It states nothing about how the judge and God connect. This adds a link the verse doesn't give and puts the unjust judge beside God.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Cards 7 and 8 both ask about verse 5. 'Keeps pestering me' and 'will wear me out with her perpetual requests' make the same point, so the second question re-asks the first.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.
